raw_fields.taker_buy_volume: Binance native 15m kline taker-buy base-asset volume

flow_feature_rule.window: Exactly 48 continuous UTC 15m bars in [key_open_ms, confirmation_ms); the final bar closes exactly at confirmation_ms.
flow_feature_rule.actual_clock: For each Binance signal, use its own entry_ms as confirmation and entry_ms-12h as the key open.
flow_feature_rule.control_clock: For each matched Binance control, use its own entry_ms as confirmation and entry_ms-12h as the key open; never reuse its parent's signal clock.
invalid_windows: taker-buy base volume above total base volume
flow_feature_rule.invalid_data_policy: Retain in the event screen with an explicit flow_status; never qualify. No proxy or imputation.
